'''Holess''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Holessian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It had more laws than any other world. Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] was the location of the [[Mount of Justice]]. Most of the population lived in towering cities built with the wealth derived from thousands of years of exporting the planet's rich local deposits of [[Duranium/Legends|duranium]].
